'''Otavon XII''', also written '''Otavon 12''' and sometimes called simply "'''Otavon'''", was a forested [[Planet/Legends|planet]] inhabited by the [[Ovoni]].

During the early years of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established [[Tremor Base]], an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] production facility, on the planet. However, Tremor base was [[Battle of Otavon XII|destroyed]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by Ovoni rebels.
